text.uk: The jury that convicted Lucy Letby never heard that Prof Peter Hindmarsh, a key witness, was barred from treating patients during the trial. Burnham and Badenoch clash over welfare cuts for young people at PMQs, and at the Apec summit in Shenzhen, Trump and Putin shake hands as Xi hails the city's transformation. Mahmood calls police leadership 'frankly inadequate', and Mary Peltola wins Alaska's Senate seat for the Democrats.
text.us: Mary Peltola becomes the first Alaska Native in the US Senate after beating Republican Dan Sullivan, giving Democrats 56 seats. At the Apec summit in Shenzhen, Trump and Putin shake hands before the welcome banquet and Xi hails the city's transformation. A key Hegseth adviser faces conflict-of-interest questions, fears grow of US sanctions on ICJ judges, and the US loses its measles elimination status.
text.au: An inquest into four baby deaths in northern NSW hears that a Byron Bay doula left a newborn to inflate a jumping castle. A report claims 'phantom forests' in the outback generate carbon credits, which companies reject, while at Apec in Shenzhen Trump and Putin shake hands and Xi hails the city's transformation. One Nation's plan to cut the refugee programme draws wide condemnation, and Australians prepare for the GTA VI launch.
text.europe: At the Apec summit in Shenzhen, Trump and Putin shake hands before the welcome banquet and Xi hails the city's transformation. The jury that convicted Lucy Letby never heard that a key medical witness was barred from treating patients during the trial. Von der Leyen urges all EU members to back a €45bn Ukraine loan, and a man faces charges over axe damage to a US military plane at Shannon airport.
